defect: ArrowMetadataGetValue declares 'int64_t size' that is never used, which breaks the build when warnings are treated as errors.
reason: The unused variable is in the new file this change added, and the fix only deletes it to repair the warnings-as-errors compile failure.

defect: Flush became fallible (FOR subtraction may overflow) but BitpackingFinalAnalyze, Append and Finalize ignore its false return, so an overflowing final partial group still selects bitpacking and then trips the assert or drops/overruns the buffer during compression.
reason: The overflow-check design and the ignored bool returns are lines this change added; the fix replaces them with a per-value range check in Update so every group, including the last partial one, is validated.

defect: Regenerating the function list from stale JSON registered epoch_ms/epoch_us/epoch_ns and make_timestamp as single functions (and renamed the epoch structs), while the implementations still define ScalarFunctionSet GetFunctions(), so the build breaks.
reason: The changed DUCKDB_SCALAR_FUNCTION lines are exactly what the fix turns back into DUCKDB_SCALAR_FUNCTION_SET, together with the JSON and header.

defect: System headers windows.h and delayimp.h are included with double quotes, which the amalgamation script treats as DuckDB-internal includes and fails on ('Could not find include file') since duckdb.hpp includes this header.
reason: The quoted includes are in the new file and break the amalgamation build; the fix switches them to angle brackets.

defect: The new date/time/timestamp cast benchmarks query column i although the tables are created with column d; the fix corrects the column name in the benchmark queries.
reason: The broken code and the fix are confined to benchmark (test) code, which the instructions class as a test change rather than a product defect.

defect: TemplatedOptimumArray compares a single child element at the parent row index instead of iterating over all array_size elements at lidx*array_size+i, so min/max over ARRAY values is wrong.
reason: The broken comparison is in the function this change added, and the fix rewrites exactly that body to loop over the array elements with correct child offsets.

defect: EXPORT was added to the single-child sink case, which unconditionally reads op->children[0], but EXPORT of an empty database has no child, causing an out-of-bounds access.
reason: The added case label is what the fix replaces with a separate EXPORT branch that returns when there are no children.

defect: A leftover debug Printer::Print(value_expr->ToString()) prints the schema value on every USE statement transformed by the PEG parser.
reason: The stray print was added by this change and the fix only removes it.

defect: EliminateCandidateFormats (void, popping failed formats from the shared DateFormatMap) empties the format list for all JSON fields as soon as one field fails to parse, so date/timestamp detection fails for later fields.
reason: The shared-map elimination logic and its void signature were introduced by this change; the fix makes it return bool and only trims formats after a success, the defect being visible in json_structure.cpp rather than this header.

defect: To make SQLColAttribute report NUM_PREC_RADIX 0, the change rewrote the shared type-info table from -1 to 0, which also changed the NUM_PREC_RADIX column returned by SQLGetTypeInfo and broke its catalog test.
reason: The fix restores -1 in exactly these table rows and moves the -1 to 0 mapping into DescRecord::SetSqlDescType, undoing the unintended SQLGetTypeInfo change.

defect: The new D_ASSERT(InMemory()) in GetOffset is wrong, because Get() pins on-disk buffers and FixedSizeAllocator::New calls GetOffset on buffers with free space that are only on disk, so debug builds abort.
reason: The assertion was added by this change and the fix removes exactly this assertion as part of the vacuum edge-case fix.

defect: The added assertions require the input and result vectors to have different auxiliary/buffer pointers, which fails whenever both are null (e.g. most vectors have no auxiliary), so debug builds abort on valid queries.
reason: The fix relaxes exactly these new assertions to allow nullptr.

defect: CreateStructPack now maps a two-part name only to BindingAlias(schema, table), dropping the old check that also accepted catalog.table, so implicit struct_pack of 'database.table' no longer binds.
reason: The rewritten alias lookup is this change's code, and the fix adds the catalog.table fallback for the two-part case.

defect: ScanCount returns the stored absolute child offsets without rebasing them to the scanned child vector, and advances the validity state by NextVector, so lists in any vector after the first point at wrong child rows.
reason: Append stores start_offset-based absolute offsets and ScanCount in the same new file never subtracts first_entry.offset; the fix adds that shift and the proper state advance.

defect: CastFromDate::Operation returns a raw new char[] that the vector cast and Value cast callers never free, leaking memory on every date-to-string conversion.
reason: The new[] allocation was introduced by this change and the fix replaces it by returning std::string, explicitly to fix the leak.

defect: For ORDER BY a non-integer constant the new OrderBinder returns the unbound constant, while the caller asserts the result is a BOUND_COLUMN_REF and uses it as an order expression.
reason: The fix changes exactly this return to BindResult(nullptr) so the constant ORDER term is dropped.

defect: The added early return when the remaining build partitions are all empty leaves the HT unfinalized, which the caller reads as 'done', so the matching probe-side partitions are never processed (lost rows for left/anti/outer external joins).
reason: The fix deletes this early return so such rounds run with an empty build side and the probe partitions are still handled.

defect: FinalizeExternal was turned into a void PrepareExternalFinalize that no longer finalizes the HT, but PreparePartitionedRound still checks hash_table->finalized to detect the end, so the external join stops after the first partitioned round.
reason: The fix changes this declaration to return bool and makes the caller use that result and finalize the HT itself.

defect: OFFSET_SIZE_MINUS_ONE_SHIFT is 5, but the variant metadata header stores offset_size_minus_one in bits 6-7, so the offset size is decoded wrongly.
reason: The constant was added by this change and the fix sets it to 6; seeing the error needs the Parquet variant specification.

defect: Making right_sel a member reused across iterations lets right_slice (and thus the lambda result referenced by left_slice) keep sharing a selection buffer that the next iteration overwrites, corrupting reduce results.
reason: Before this change right_sel was a fresh local each iteration; the fix moves it back to a per-iteration local 'to prevent referencing issues'.

defect: TableIndex::FindForeignKeyIndex calls IsForeignKeyIndex, which is a file-static function in data_table.cpp, so the file only compiles in unity builds that happen to merge both files.
reason: The fix ('Fix CI') makes it DataTable::IsForeignKeyIndex and includes data_table.hpp, repairing the compile failure in this new file.

defect: VariantColumnStatsData::GetOrCreateElement/GetOrCreateField emplace into stats.columns, the vector that holds 'this', then write to this->element_stats/field_stats, a use-after-free on reallocation.
reason: The fix moves these methods to VariantStatsData working with parent indices and stores the index in the element, removing the dangling-this design this change introduced.

defect: UnshreddedVariantValue returns NULL when input.RowIsValid(row) is true, an inverted check that turns every valid unshredded row into NULL.
reason: The fix negates exactly this new condition (and adjusts the reserved index 0).

defect: An internal header is included with angle brackets (<duckdb/planner/tableref/bound_cteref.hpp>), which the amalgamation script does not inline, so the amalgamated build cannot find it.
reason: The fix converts this include to the quoted form (and drops unused includes), repairing the amalgamation build.

defect: The DATE branch's error message wrongly says 'DATE_INTEGER'; the fix only rewords the message.
reason: The fix changes error-message text, not behaviour.

defect: The overrides use glibc-internal typedefs __uint8_t and __int64_t instead of uint8_t and int64_t, which do not exist on other toolchains such as MSVC, breaking the Python package build there.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these non-portable types in declarations this change added.

defect: The single-threaded-finalize condition requires a small HT AND high skew, so small HTs now go parallel and large skewed HTs still slam the same atomics, the opposite of the stated intent.
reason: The fix changes this new '&&' to '||', so the finalize goes single-threaded when the HT is small or the data is skewed.

defect: ProbeAndSink builds the scan structure (keys prepared, found_match for outer joins) over the whole chunk and only restricts probing by a selection, without slicing out the sunk rows, so external left/right/outer joins also emit sunk rows as unmatched.
reason: The fix removes this change's up-front scan-structure and Hash(keys, *current_sel, ...) lines and instead slices keys and payload to the probe rows before building the scan structure.
